overall: The AG found the Board violated the Open Meeting Law by creating insufficiently detailed March 21 minutes, and declined to review the untimely notice-specificity allegation.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the March 21 meeting notice, including its executive session item on abatements, was not sufficiently specific.
allegations.key_passage: We decline to review the allegation that the meeting notice was not sufficiently specific, as the complaint was untimely as to that allegation.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the minutes of the March 21 Board of Assessors meeting, covering abatement applications in executive session, were not sufficiently detailed.
allegations.key_passage: For the reasons stated above, we find that the Board violated the Open Meeting Law by failing to create adequate minutes of the March 21 executive session.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law
Amend the minutes of the March 21 meeting consistent with the guidance in the letter
Certify compliance with the order within 40 days of the letter
remedy_passage: We order the Board’s immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law
